content: अर्मः, -र्मम् [ऋ-मन् <ls>Uṇ. 1. 137</ls>] .²1 A disease of the eye. .²2 A country to which one should go (गन्तव्यदेशः or चिरन्तनग्रामनिवासः). .²3 A cemetery. .²4 (<ab>pl.</ab>) Ruins, rubbish; <ls>Vāj. 30. 11</ls>.
